verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack Ionian Fervor and Q off free minions in extended trades; you win if you land W (Infernal Chains) first and end the fight before her passive caps out.

brief.thesis: Irelia's whole kit is built around forcing short trades she controls — Q (Bladesurge) needs a target inside 600 range to dash off and heal, and every spell hit stacks Ionian Fervor toward bonus on-hit damage. Aatrox vs Irelia sits at 45.6% over 726 games because Aatrox's tools (W drag, three-swing Q, E dash-heal) are strongest in a committed all-in, and Irelia is built to punish exactly that if her E (Flawless Duet) is up. Strip her Q reset targets and fight only when her E is down.

theirWindow.when: her E is up and minions sit near her
theirWindow.what: She can stun with E, then Q off a minion or your champion to close and heal, all while stacking passive attack speed. Do not extend a trade here — stay outside 850 range until her E is confirmed down.

yourWindow.when: her E just went down (used, on cooldown)
yourWindow.what: Open with W (Infernal Chains) from 825 range — she has no stun to punish your commitment. Follow with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and use E (Umbral Dash) to close and heal off the damage you land.

start.why: 50.3% win rate over 296 games — the passive damage reduction and regen blunt her Q-into-auto poke pattern better than raw stats early.

boots.why: 47.4% win rate over 797 games and 93.3% pick — she's an auto-attack-reliant melee, and the flat physical reduction cuts her Q/passive-stacked autos directly.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (63.6% over 44 games) — the shield and burst proc match the short, decisive trades you want against her Q sustain.
Part of the same 63.6% path — the on-hit heal and proc reward landing your empowered Q swings in the all-in window.
Closes out the top core path — bleeds through her burst and keeps you alive through her passive-stacked auto damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive damage and healing rewards the exact prolonged-skirmish pattern you're forcing once you strip her Q reset — and matches OP.GG's own note to track stack counts in this fight.

summoners.why: Highest win rate and by far the most-picked combo (47.1% win, 74.3% pick) — Ignite punishes her Q heal directly and secures the short trades this matchup is built around.

playing.title: Open with W, not Q
playing.detail: Infernal Chains hits the first enemy and drags them back to the impact point if they don't leave fast — use it first at 825 range to force the double-hit before she can charge W (Defiant Dance) for the reduced-damage window.

playing.title: Starve her Q reset
playing.detail: Bladesurge needs a target within 600 range to dash to, and it refreshes only if that target is Marked or dies. Push or freeze the wave so she has nothing to dash off when you commit.

playing.title: Never all-in into her E
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks anything caught between the two converging blades at 850 range. Track her E cooldown (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s by rank) all lane and only commit once it's down.

playing.title: Bank E for the fight, not the poke
playing.detail: Umbral Dash's short cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s) lets you loop in and out, but its heal only triggers on champion damage — save the dash for your actual engage window, not for farming.

playing.title: Time all-ins to Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Your passive empowers your next auto with bonus magic damage and a heal off her max health. Don't commit your combo until you can see the stance is up — it's the swing damage that wins short trades.

playing.title: Use R to erase her wave leverage
playing.detail: World Ender fears nearby enemy minions in addition to buffing your AD, healing, and move speed. In a level 6+ skirmish this removes any minion she could Bladesurge off to reset or escape.

playing.title: Fight in bursts, not extended trades
playing.detail: Her Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed and eventually bonus on-hit damage the longer a fight runs. Land your combo, get the Deathbringer/E heal value, and disengage rather than standing in extended auto exchanges.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out for Irelia’s (P) and Conqueror stacks. Rather than fighting in prolonged fights, aim for small bursts of damage. Avoid her (E) while fighting her.
